HirePathAI is an AI-powered job portal designed to make the job search and recruitment process easier, faster, and more efficient for students, freshers, and job seekers. In today's competitive world, finding a suitable job according to educational qualifications, skills, experience, and career interests is a major challenge. Many candidates are unable to identify the skills required for their desired jobs or prepare a professional resume. HirePathAI aims to solve these problems by providing a smart and user-friendly platform that connects job seekers with suitable career opportunities. The main objective of this project is to help candidates find relevant jobs, analyze their resumes, identify missing skills, and improve their professional profiles. The system provides various features to support users throughout their job search journey.

HirePathAI aims to reduce the time and effort required for job searching by providing multiple career-related services on a single platform. It helps candidates understand their skill gaps, improve their resumes, develop new skills, and find suitable employment opportunities. Overall, HirePathAI provides a smart and organized approach to job searching and career development by using Artificial Intelligence to improve the job-seeking experience and help candidates move towards better career opportunities.

HirePathAI is a web-based job portal developed to help students, freshers, and job seekers find suitable employment opportunities. The idea behind this project is to make the job searching process easier by bringing different career-related facilities together on one platform. Finding a suitable job is not always easy, especially for candidates who are starting their careers. Many students complete their education but are not fully aware of the technical skills required by companies. Some candidates also face problems while preparing their resumes or selecting jobs according to their abilities. HirePathAI provides a platform where users can explore job opportunities, select their desired job roles, upload resumes, and check whether their skills match the selected job requirements. It also helps candidates find the skills they need to improve and provides YouTube learning links for further learning. The system focuses on connecting a candidate's existing skills with the requirements of available jobs. Its main purpose is to help users make better career decisions and prepare themselves for employment opportunities.

HirePathAI is designed as an online platform that supports candidates during different stages of their job search. It provides facilities for account creation, job exploration, resume checking, skill improvement, and job applications. A user first registers or logs in to the portal. After entering the platform, the user can explore different companies and available job positions. Once a suitable job is selected, the

candidate can upload a resume for analysis. The resume analysis facility examines the skills present in the uploaded resume and compares them with the requirements of the selected job. If some required skills are not found, the system identifies them as missing skills. This gives candidates a clearer idea of what they should learn before applying for a particular position. The portal also provides YouTube learning links related to missing skills. Users can follow these resources to improve their technical knowledge. In addition, the resume builder facility helps candidates prepare or improve their resumes. The main facilities provided by HirePathAI are:
By combining these facilities, HirePathAI aims to make the job search process more organized and useful for candidates.

The main objective of HirePathAI is to develop a job portal that helps candidates search for suitable jobs and understand the skills required to achieve their career goals. The specific objectives of the project are:
The overall aim is to provide candidates with useful information and facilities that can support them in preparing for employment.

HirePathAI is mainly intended for people who are searching for employment or preparing themselves for future career opportunities. Different types of users can benefit from the facilities provided by the system.

Students who are pursuing graduation or other professional courses can use the portal to explore job opportunities. They can also understand which technical skills are useful for the career they want to choose.

Freshers who have recently completed their education can use HirePathAI to search for entry-level positions. The resume analysis and missing skill detection facilities can help them understand the requirements of different job roles.
People who are looking for new employment opportunities can explore available jobs and compare their existing skills with the requirements of selected positions.

Users who want to learn new technologies or improve their existing knowledge can use the YouTube learning links provided by the portal. These resources can help them work on the skills required for their desired jobs.

People who are unsure about which job role is suitable for their qualifications can explore different opportunities and understand the skills expected for those positions. Therefore, HirePathAI is useful for candidates at different stages of their education and professional journey.
Searching for a suitable job is a difficult process for many students, freshers, and job

seekers. Although several online job portals are available, candidates may still struggle to understand which opportunities are suitable for their current skills and qualifications. One common problem is that candidates often apply for jobs without checking all the skills mentioned in the job description. They may have some of the required skills but lack others that are important for the selected position. Without proper guidance, it becomes difficult for them to identify these gaps. Resume preparation is another challenge. Many freshers do not have enough experience in creating a well-organized resume. They may also be unaware of how to improve their resumes according to different job requirements. Candidates also spend time searching for learning materials when they discover that they need additional technical skills. Finding useful resources for the right topic can become another part of the job preparation process. The major problems are:

HirePathAI is developed to address these difficulties through a single online platform. It allows users to explore jobs, upload resumes, check their skills, and identify the requirements they still need to fulfil. The portal also provides YouTube learning links and resume-building facilities to support candidates in improving their job readiness. The system aims to make the job searching and preparation process more convenient by providing these facilities in one place.

A job portal is an online platform that helps people search for employment opportunities and allows companies to share information about vacant positions. It provides a common place where job seekers can explore different career options without visiting companies individually. In earlier times, people mainly depended on newspapers, personal contacts, advertisements, and direct visits to companies to find jobs. With the growth of internet technology, the process of searching and applying for jobs has become more convenient. Candidates can now explore job openings, read job descriptions, and submit their resumes through online platforms. Job portals are useful for both candidates and employers. Candidates can search for jobs according to their qualifications, experience, and interests, while employers can publish vacancies and receive applications from interested people. HirePathAI is developed with the same basic purpose of providing job-related services. However, it also focuses on resume analysis and missing skill identification to help candidates understand their preparation level for a selected job.

Several online job portals are available today that help candidates find employment opportunities. These platforms provide facilities such as job searching, resume uploading, company information, and online applications. Some commonly known job portals are:

LinkedIn is a professional networking platform where users can create professional profiles, connect with other people, search for jobs, and interact with companies. It also helps candidates build professional connections and explore career opportunities.
Indeed is an online job-search platform where candidates can explore job vacancies from different employers. Users can search for positions using job titles, keywords, and locations.
Naukri.com is a popular Indian job portal that allows candidates to create profiles, upload resumes, search for vacancies, and apply for suitable positions.

Glassdoor provides job-search facilities along with company reviews, salary information, and workplace-related details. It helps candidates learn more about organizations before applying. Comparison of Existing Job Portals with HirePathAI

Existing job portals provide useful services for finding employment. However, HirePathAI focuses on bringing job searching together with skill-gap identification and learning support. This gives candidates additional guidance while preparing for their desired job roles.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a technology that enables computer systems to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding information, identifying patterns, and making predictions. In recruitment, AI can help process candidate information and support different activities involved in finding suitable employees. It can be used to examine resumes, identify relevant skills, compare candidate profiles with job descriptions, and suggest suitable job opportunities.
AI-based tools can examine information present in resumes and identify details such as education, experience, technical skills, and qualifications. This can help organize candidate information.
AI-based techniques can help identify skills mentioned in a resume and compare them with the skills required for a particular job position.
Recommendation systems can suggest job opportunities by comparing candidate information with job requirements.
A matching system can calculate a score based on the skills or other criteria shared between a candidate's profile and a job description.
AI tools can help organize applications and reduce repetitive work during the initial stages of recruitment.

AI-supported platforms can identify areas where candidates need improvement and suggest relevant learning resources. Research on AI recruitment also highlights the importance of accuracy, transparency, and fairness. AI systems should be designed carefully because incorrect or biased data can affect their recommendations. These facilities aim to help candidates understand how their current skills relate to their desired job roles.

A resume contains important information about a candidate, such as educational qualifications, technical skills, projects, certifications, and work experience. Employers use this information to understand whether a candidate is suitable for a particular position. Resume analysis is the process of examining the information provided in a resume and identifying details that are relevant to a job requirement. Job matching is the process of comparing a candidate's qualifications and skills with the requirements of a job. It helps identify how closely a candidate's profile matches a particular position. The main steps involved in resume analysis and job matching are:
The candidate uploads a resume to the platform. The resume acts as the source of information for checking the candidate's skills and qualifications.
The system examines the uploaded resume to identify relevant information, such as technical skills, education, and experience.
The required skills and qualifications are identified from the selected job description.
The candidate's available skills are compared with the skills required for the selected job.
Skills that are required for the job but are not found in the resume are identified as missing skills.
A matching score can be used to represent how closely the candidate's available skills match the selected job requirements.

Learning resources can be provided to help candidates improve the skills they need for their desired position. In HirePathAI, these steps help users understand their current skill level in relation to a selected job. Instead of only searching for vacancies, candidates can also identify the areas where they need improvement. Studies of job recommendation systems discuss different approaches to representing job requirements and candidate skills. They also highlight the need for understandable and fair recommendations. A Data Flow Diagram (DFD) is a graphical representation of how information moves through a system. It explains how data is received, processed, stored, and transferred between different components. DFD helps developers understand the internal working of an application without focusing on programming details. In HirePathAI, the Data Flow Diagram represents the movement of information from the candidate to the different modules of the job portal.

The context-level DFD represents the complete HirePathAI application as a single process. It shows the relationship between the external user and the system. The candidate provides registration details, login information, job preferences, and resume files. The system processes this information and returns the required results.

Level 1 DFD provides a detailed view of the internal processes of HirePathAI. It divides the main application into smaller processes. The major processes include user authentication, job selection, resume uploading, resume analysis, skill comparison, job recommendation, and job application.
The DFD explains how different processes are connected and how information moves throughout the application.

A Use Case Diagram is used to represent the interaction between users and the functionalities of a software system. It describes what a user can perform using the application. In HirePathAI, the main actor is the Job Seeker. The job seeker interacts with different functions of the system to search for employment opportunities and improve their career profile.

The Job Seeker is the primary actor of the system. The user first registers or logs into the platform. After successful login, the user can access the dashboard and select the desired job or company. The user can upload a resume, view the analysis results, identify missing skills, and access learning resources. The user can also search and apply for suitable job opportunities. The Use Case Diagram provides a clear overview of the functionalities available to candidates.

An Activity Diagram is a type of UML (Unified Modeling Language) diagram that represents the flow of activities performed in a system. It explains the sequence of operations from the beginning to the completion of a particular task. It also represents decisions and alternative paths during the execution of a process. In HirePathAI, the Activity Diagram describes how a candidate uses the job portal, starting from registration or login and continuing to resume analysis and job application.

The activity begins when the candidate opens the application and registers or logs into the system. The system verifies the user's login information. If the information is incorrect, the user is asked to try again. If the information is valid, the

dashboard is displayed. The candidate then selects a job or company and uploads a resume. The system analyses the resume and compares the available skills with the required skills. If missing skills are identified, the system displays them and provides relevant learning resources. Finally, job recommendations are displayed, and the candidate can search and apply for suitable opportunities. The Activity Diagram explains the complete working process and decision-making activities of the HirePathAI system.

Module design explains how the HirePathAI application is divided into different functional parts. Each module performs a particular operation and contributes to the overall working of the system. The modular approach makes the application easier to develop, maintain, test, and improve. The major modules of HirePathAI are described below.
This module provides authentication facilities to users. New candidates can register by entering the required details. Existing users can log in using their registered credentials. Main functions:

This module maintains the candidate's personal and professional information. It may include the candidate's name, email, educational qualification, skills, and experience. The information helps the system understand the candidate's background.

This module allows candidates to select their preferred company or job position. For example, a candidate interested in web development can select a Frontend Developer or React Developer position. The selected job requirements are used during the resume analysis and skill comparison process.

This module allows users to upload their resumes through the application. The uploaded resume contains important details such as education, technical skills, projects, and experience. The resume is submitted for further processing and analysis.

This module analyses the information available in the candidate's resume. It identifies relevant details, including educational qualifications, technical skills, and work experience. The extracted information helps the system compare the candidate's profile with the requirements of a selected job.

This module identifies the skills that are required for a selected job but are not found in the candidate's resume. For example, if a job requires HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js, but the resume contains only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, React and Node.js can be identified as missing skills. This information helps candidates understand which technical skills they need to improve.

This module provides suitable job suggestions according to the candidate's available information. It considers the candidate's skills, education, experience, and job preferences. The system can also display a matching score to show how closely the candidate's profile matches a job's requirements.

This module provides YouTube learning links related to missing skills. For example, if React is identified as a missing skill, the candidate can access relevant React tutorials. This feature helps candidates improve their technical knowledge and prepare for future opportunities.

This module helps candidates create or improve their resumes. A properly structured resume presents the candidate's education, skills, projects, and experience in an organized manner. It is useful for candidates who need assistance preparing a professional resume.

This module allows candidates to search for available job opportunities and apply for suitable positions. Users can explore jobs according to their interests and select appropriate opportunities. It completes the main job-searching process of the application.

A matching score represents the similarity between the candidate's available skills and the required skills of a selected job. A basic skill-based matching score can be calculated using the following formula: Matching Score = (Matched Skills / Total Required Skills) × 100 For example: Total required skills = 5 Matched skills = 4 Matching Score = (4 / 5) × 100 Matching Score = 80% This means that 4 out of the 5 required skills were identified in the candidate's profile. The score is an illustrative example. A complete recommendation system may also consider education, experience, and other factors.
